# opnsense_auth_privilege (Resource)

Assigns one privilege to users and groups (System > Access > Privileges). This resource is **authoritative** for the privilege: users and groups not listed lose it, and destroying the resource removes it from everyone, including built-in grants such as `page-all` for `admins`. It edits the same data as `privileges` on `opnsense_auth_user` and `opnsense_auth_group`; manage each privilege in one place only.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "opnsense_auth_group" "helpdesk" {
  name = "helpdesk"
}

# Authoritative: only the helpdesk group holds this privilege.
resource "opnsense_auth_privilege" "arp_table" {
  privilege = "page-diagnostics-arptable"
  groups    = [opnsense_auth_group.helpdesk.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `privilege` (String) Privilege ID, e.g. `page-diagnostics-arptable`. Changing it forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `groups` (Set of String) UUIDs of groups holding the privilege (`opnsense_auth_group.<name>.id`). Defaults to `[]`.
- `users` (Set of String) UUIDs of users holding the privilege (`opnsense_auth_user.<name>.id`). Defaults to `[]`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same as `privilege`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by privilege ID
terraform import opnsense_auth_privilege.example page-diagnostics-arptable
```
